name: Dorsian Forge
description: Hidden in Undertanares, the Dorsian Forge is the best achievement of the ancient dwarves. It is the mightiest forge on the Material Plane, designed to craft weapons formidable enough to counter the Ungods’ invasion. It consists of multiple smaller forges, with each one handling different aspects of item creation, such as magma and ice forges, and can be combined into one colossal single forge using an activation mechanism. It can forge any magic item or unique artifact as long as the blacksmith possesses detailed instructions and components for its creation. It also can combine tameranium and bauronite to create moonstone, the rarest and most powerful mineral. It even has the capability to transform base materials, such as iron, into precious metals like adamantine or mithral. Weapons forged here gain a unique ability, which may vary based on the forging process. The most common is the accurate burst, granting advantage for one attack roll once per hour, or memory metal, containing memories of their last wielder. The duergar control the forge, but they have not yet been able to activate the combined forge. Even utilizing its basic capabilities, they can craft formidable weapons. Additionally, Drogolin discovered a metallic statue shaped like a dwarf. His priests have found the means to create the Iron Spirits using the soul of Skrabolin. If the duergars learn how to mass-produce these statues, their army will be much more powerful. As expected, the dwarves pay large sums of gold for anyone capable of reclaiming this forge.
